pages.text: $(thing)Metabolism$()$(br2)A cell is a chemical network: hundreds of enzymes in chains and cycles, each feeding the next. Unlocks the Fermenter.

$(thing)Insight$(): 70$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Membranes, Enzyme Kinetics.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Assayed Enzyme.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A chain of n enzymes each passes on a share f of what it is given. A amount of sugar goes in; write the amount Y that reaches the end.
